video_title: It's time to go big or go home...or maybe a bit of both
evidence: SponsorRadar records Fanttik sponsoring SYD and MACKY's August 8, 2026 English-language YouTube video; the channel has about 132K subscribers and the description states the video is sponsored by Fanttik. SponsorRadar also records Fanttik creator integrations as recent as August 12, 2026 across 142 creators. Fanttik sells tangible automotive, outdoor, home-improvement and personal-care hardware. Its official affiliate program actively recruits social-platform promoters and publishes publish@fanttik.com as the official Affiliate Team email; its official contact page separately publishes marketing@fanttik.com for marketing partnerships.
